Anil Verma
Data Engineer | Chennai, Tamil Nadu
anil.verma837@example.com | +91 9522425514

Experienced data engineer focused on building reliable, scalable data pipelines and analytics platforms. Skilled at translating business requirements into ETL/ELT solutions, optimizing query performance, and enabling self-service analytics. Strong collaborator with stakeholders and cross-functional teams to deliver measurable improvements in data availability and latency. Notice period: 90 days.

Experience

Razorpay — Dec 2024 - Present
Data Engineer | Remote
- Implemented PySpark-based ingestion workflows on AWS to process payment event streams, reducing end-to-end latency by 35% and handling a 4x increase in peak throughput using partitioning and tuned parallelism (Python, PySpark, SQL, Snowflake).
- Designed and implemented Snowflake data models and automated ELT pipelines with dbt, improving query performance for finance reports by 50% and cutting data transformation costs by 22% (Snowflake, dbt, SQL).
- Built automated data quality checks and alerting in Confluence/Jira-driven cadence, catching schema drift and preventing production incidents; decreased data incidents by 60% within three months (Python 3, Jira, Confluence).
- Collaborated with analytics and product teams to deliver a reusable event schema and a set of standardized SQL views, enabling self-serve reporting and reducing ad-hoc data requests by 40% (SQL, Snowflake).

Accenture — Apr 2021 - Nov 2024
Big Data Engineer | Hybrid
- Developed PySpark ETL pipelines on AWS EMR to process large customer datasets, improving batch processing speed by 3x through optimized Spark configurations and efficient data formats (PySpark, Apache Spark, AWS).
- Migrated legacy warehouse tables to Snowflake and reimplemented transforms with dbt, resulting in a 45% reduction in compute costs and a 30% improvement in query response times (Snowflake, dbt, SQL).
- Created incremental load patterns and CDC-enabled jobs to keep analytical datasets fresh; achieved near-real-time availability for business KPIs with SLA adherence above 99% (Python 3, SQL, Snowflake).
- Drove knowledge sharing via Confluence documentation and Jira-managed sprints; mentored junior engineers on Spark best practices and SQL tuning, improving team throughput and code quality (Confluence, Jira, Apache Spark).

Projects
- Payment Anomaly Detector: Built a PySpark pipeline to flag anomalous transactions using statistical rules and aggregated features stored in Snowflake; reduced fraud investigation time by 25% (Python 3, PySpark, Snowflake).
- Cost Optimization Dashboard: Developed SQL/Snowflake dashboards and dbt models to track pipeline cost and utilization, identifying hotspots that led to a 20% reduction in monthly data platform spend (SQL, Snowflake, dbt).

Languages: Python 3, SQL
Stack: Apache Spark, PySpark, Snowflake, dbt, AWS
Tools: Jira, Confluence

B.Tech, Computer Science, VIT Vellore
